## createSarifDocument() function

Creates a SARIF document with one empty run, ready for[addSarifComment()](./sarif-to-comment.addsarifcomment.md)<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function createSarifDocument(options?: ICreateSarifDocumentOptions): ISarifLog;
```

**Returns:**

[ISarifLog](./sarif-to-comment.isariflog.md)

A new SARIF log.

## Exceptions

`TypeError` for malformed options.

## Remarks

The result is ordinary SARIF: it has the schema URI, version `2.1.0` and one run with the tool, `columnKind: "utf16CodeUnits"`<!-- -->, the optional binding and no results. It carries no authoring marker, and nothing else in the package requires a document to have been created this way.

## Example


```ts
import { createSarifDocument } from 'sarif-to-comment';

let sarif = createSarifDocument({ tool: { name: 'Review agent' } });
```
